findings.claim: The new sweeper line reads "the goldens and assertions a test reads stay identical". It drops the explicit "test assertions" wording, so a fixture the sweeper judges orphaned could be deleted while a test that does read it (through a glob or from another package) is still green. The only guard is the existing rule that a deletion that turns a test red was live. A fixture read through a glob is covered by the CHANGELOG instruction to answer `live` with the test, but the role text itself does not say so. The change is wording only and has no concrete failure.

evidence: The three runtime role files (agents/, pi/agents/, codex/agents/) carry a byte-identical new line to roles/sweeper/body.md.
The new test checks that exact line once in each of the four files.

The proposals line in skills/sweeper/SKILL.md says to relay each proposal to the owner and run a command only after the owner confirms it. This matches the CHANGELOG description of `review proposals` as printing and never running.
Grep found 'T1 to T4' in engine/cmd/usage.go and review_sweep_test.go, so the T1-T4 wording in the skill and the sweep.go comment is consistent with the CLI.

Only a stale 'T1-T3' remains in docs/architecture/role-design/per-role-sweeper.md:70, which is design history. A stale test comment at review_sweep_test.go:285 and an error message at :341 are untouched by this diff.
